For this example without crossing over, two gametes have long red/short blue, two long blue/short red. No X chromosomes in final daughters or gametes. Large numerals "2n = 4" at parent/mitosis and "n = 2" at meiosis are allowed. Use enough spacing to count every chromosome at360px; no decorative extra rod shapes or nuclei mistaken for chromosomes.
